biggest_catch: Your friend has to register through your referral link, open an eligible account or loan within 180 days, AND complete the offer's activity requirements (e.g., direct deposits for checking). A friend who registers and opens an account but never completes the requirements earns you nothing.
catches: Friend must register for the program via the referrer's referral link, open a new Commerce personal checking account, personal loan, or vehicle loan within 180 days of receiving the offer, and complete the additional requirements of the offer within the time specified.
Referrer earns a $100 Visa Reward Card per qualified referral; the referred person receives a Visa Reward Card worth at least $200.
Cap: maximum $1,000 in Visa Reward Cards per person, per calendar year (10 referrals).
Program is described as a limited-time offer on the official page.
Full offer qualifications live on ReferLive (the program platform); the commercebank.com page states the referrer payout and cap.
No 1099/tax disclosure on the fetched official page.
